targetText: As with the state, with religion. It will not be "abolished". God will not be "dethroned", religion will not be "torn out of the hearts of people"; nor will any other of the foolish accusations against Social-Democrats with atheistic leanings materialise.
summary: Bebel explains that socialism will neither forcibly prohibit religion nor persecute believers; instead, as material security, scientific education, and social solidarity replace the misery and helplessness of capitalism, religious institutions and superstitions will naturally wither away.
